title: The War Council

lines.speaker: holt
lines.en: Warrant. And — unasked — the Corbin brothers' records. Muscle for hire, recently hired. Consider it an apology shaped like a case file.

lines.speaker: adele
lines.en: The museum's keys. All of them, this time.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: Sandwiches. And a headline I still haven't printed. Don't make me regret either.

caseLine: War council: Holt's warrant, Adele's keys, Margo's sandwiches.

peopleFacts.fact: Brought the warrant and an apology shaped like a case file.
Brought the museum's keys. All of them.

title: Finch's Redemption

lines.speaker: finch
lines.en: You'll want the seal, Mr. Halloway. It's a fine old seal. That's how they fooled me.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: He found us at the station — coat, hat, and the transfer papers he swore he never kept. The nightingale watermark, retired 1921, 'not recovered.'

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: The theft signed itself. It just took us six chapters to read the signature.

caseLine: Finch kept the papers: the retired seal signed the theft.

title: Storm Bulletin

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: All sailings held. The Selene won't run — not Sunday, not for anyone.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: Then where does a nightingale go when the sea says no?

caseLine: The storm holds every sailing. The Selene won't run.

title: For the Wren

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Her crate abandoned, her ticket unused, her brooch left for the wren. Halloway, seasick on a moored pontoon, solves better ashore anyway.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: She kept the brooch since the painting. You don't sell the thing you are, Halloway.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: The keeper points one oilskinned arm through the rain: a small figure with a long, wrapped burden, walking toward the Belmont.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: She's not escaping. — 'She's delivering,' you say. The chase inverts: a homecoming, and we're following it.

caseLine: Ticket unused. Brooch left for me. She's walking the painting home.

title: Twice a Crime Scene

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: The Corbin brothers, in bracelets, indignant at everything: 'We was promised a percentage.'

lines.speaker: holt
lines.en: Percentage of what, gentlemen? Speak up for the record.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: Their crudeness against the Broker's tidiness closes the arc: the ransack was never her. The gallery is a crime scene twice over — and the trail goes up.

caseLine: The Corbins ransacked and are wearing bracelets. The trail goes up.

peopleFacts.fact: Collared the Corbins. Welcome to it.

title: The Rooftop

lines.speaker: ottilie
lines.en: You're late, little wren. I've been holding the truth level for six years.

lines.speaker: narration
lines.en: The old conservation studio under the storm glass. The original, unrolled, in lamplight. The whole case laid out on her worktable — a conservator ends a job with a full inventory.

lines.speaker: margo
lines.en: Go on, Halloway. Finish the sentence. I'll hold the light.

caseLine: The rooftop. She waits with the truth held level.

peopleFacts.fact: Waiting on the rooftop, hands folded, storm overhead.
